answer_1.quote: In the task of Table to Text Generation, the output summaries usually are of two types: Descriptive and Analytical.

answer_2.quote: We use several automatic metrics to measure the relative quality of the generated sentences compared to the reference: BLEU, ROUGE-L, semantic similarity with sentence embeddings using the MPNet model; (ii) Between the tables and generated sentences: PARENT.

answer_4.quote: We sample 500 instances from the ToTTo validation set and generate their corresponding analytical sentences ... we ask the annotators to evaluate the the sentence on three questions as described in Section 3.2: Reasoning, Faithful and Coverage.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate based on three criteria: Reasoning (use of required reasoning categories), Faithful (hallucination-free), and Coverage (use of all highlighted cells).
